critical_errors_to_prevent: Even when two ancient authors use the same term Vikala, its physical predicates differ: Bhasin joins malefic; Saravali solar combustion. A universal enum silently swaps causes.
Khala in Bhasin denotes planetary-war defeat; in Saravali it denotes harmful divisional status. Equivalent strings are not equivalent models.
Debilitation in Bhasin is Heena and in Saravali is Bhita. One-to-one ordinal mapping fails.
Enemy sign in Bhasin is explicit Dukhita but Saravali instead includes bright rays Sakta; the sets are not permutations of the same nine antecedents.
Bhasin's chapter 13 applies nine states explicitly during each main ruling period; Saravali includes natal status and time effect distinctions. A full test requires different timing models.
Having nine named categories does not create nine independent predictions or imply modern medicine validity.
possible_variant_test_design: Use two source-specific named nine-state enumerations, each with independent, deterministic definition precedence and a single predeclared outcome mapping; do not merge, choose by person biography, or interpret source-silent states as contradiction.
